CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR OPPER-CHINA.
No. 866.

SHANGHAI.    21-3-1929.

Sir,

    I beg to acknowledge the receipt
of your letter No. I.O./D 103 dated
the 19th instant regarding Dr. Li
Koue Tchang and to thank you for the
information contained therein.
                I have the honour to be,
                        Sir,
                Your obedient servant,

                Chinese Secretary.

The Acting Director
of Criminal Investigation,

    S.M.P.,

        SHANGHAI.

荷兰驻上中国总领事馆
第866号。

上海。    1929年3月21日。

先生：

                谨致
                        先生，

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY
No. I. O. D. 193
Date 19. 3. 29

March 19, 29

Sir,

With reference to your letter No. 787 of
March 13, 1929, concerning Dr. Li Koue Tchang 李國昌
of China University-Chenju- I have the honour to
inform you that nothing is known by the Police against
this person.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your Obedient Servant,

Director of Criminal Investigation.

Consul General for the Netherlands,
Shanghai.

March 13, 9

Sir,

I have the honour to acknowledge the
receipt of your letter No. 787 of March 13, 1929,
concerning Dr. Li Kous Tehang (黎國昌) of the
Chinan University, Chenju, and to inform you
that the matter is receiving attention.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your Obedient Servant,

A Director of Criminal Investigation.

(批：Chinese section
This was received at
this office attached to
file B. 2092 Ab. 13.)

Consul-General for the Netherlands,
Shanghai.

谨此确认收到贵方1929年3月13日第787号来函，涉及济南大学、青州的李国昌（Li Kous Tehang (黎國昌)）博士，并告知您此事正在处理中。

谨致
先生，
您顺从的仆人，

刑事调查处处长之一。

pages.en:
C.L.O. REGISTRY
No. L O D. 19......
Date............13.3.29

CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.

No. 787.

SHANGHAI, 13th March 1929.

Sir,

Dr. Li Koue Tchang (黎國昌) of the Chinan University,
Chenju, has been named by the Nationalist Government as one
of the Chinese delegates to the Pan-Pacific Conference of
scientific studies which will be held at Java in the middle
of May. He has applied to this Consulate for a visa. I
shall feel greatly obliged if you will kindly find out whe-
ther there is any thing against him from a point of view
of politics.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,
[签名]
Consul-General.

The Director of Criminal Investigation,
S.M.P.,
SHANGHAI.
pages.zh:
领事联络官登记室
第 L O D. 19...... 号
日期............1929年3月13日

荷兰驻中中国总领事馆
电话地址 HOLLANDIA。

第787号。

上海，1929年3月13日。

先生：

济南大学、青州的李国昌（Li Koue Tchang (黎國昌)）博士已被国民政府提名为将于五月中旬在爪哇举行的泛太平洋科学研究会议的中国代表之一。他已向本领事馆申请签证。如蒙贵方查明从政治角度来看他是否有任何不良记录，本人将不胜感激。

谨致
先生，
您顺从的仆人，
[签名]
总领事。

上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事调查处处长，
上海。
